text: Four years after his wife dies giving birth to their son, the young London lawyer Arthur Kipps is [sent out to the village of Crythin Gifford|trigger|travelling somewhere remote] to sort the papers at [Eel Marsh House, an isolated marshland estate reached by a causeway|images|wild and lonely places]. The villagers are cold, and in the house he finds a bolted nursery and [a figure in black funeral clothes|threat|the restless dead]. When a girl dies in his arms after swallowing lye, he learns that [the village's children have been dying|who_suffers|young children], and his own son is due to arrive that night.
